company_context: Spectrum Hire (spectrumhire.ai) is a multi-tool B2B AI SaaS product built by a solopreneur with a physics background. It converts chaotic hiring requirements into crystal-clear data structures across three core tools: a Job Description Generator, a Weighted/Structured Interview Rubric Maker, and an Interview Prep Tool for candidates.
framework_description: Evaluating candidate brand names for the product suite described above.

personas.name: Hiring Manager
personas.description: Primary audience. Busy founder/lead at a 20-person startup. Hires 2-5x a year. Cares about utility, rapid implementation, clear outcomes, and time-saving metrics. Allergic to enterprise bloat.

personas.name: Fractional HR Consultant
personas.description: Buyer/influencer. Consultant managing talent frameworks for small-to-mid businesses. Cares about compliance, repeatable scoring systems, weighted parameters, alignment, and data trust.

personas.name: Tech Job Seeker
personas.description: Secondary audience. Mid-to-senior software engineer. Cares about evaluation transparency, objective assessment criteria, modern technical design, and bias-free pipelines.
